import Mathlib.RingTheory.LocalRing.ResidueField.Basic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Operations
import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Basic

/-!
# Taylor coefficients in a local parameter

For a local domain with residue field its coefficient field and principal
maximal ideal, removing the constant coefficient and dividing by a specified
parameter defines a linear remainder map. Its iterates give the Taylor
coefficients. The coefficients depend on the specified parameter.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Hartshorne

open IsLocalRing

noncomputable section

variable {k R : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (c0 : R →ₗ[k] k)
  (hc0 : ∀ a : R, residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 a)) = residue R a)
  (t : R) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t})

include hc0 ht in
omit [IsDomain R] in
private theorem exists_localTaylorRemainder (a : R) :
    ∃ b : R, t * b = a - algebraMap k R (c0 a) := by
  have hmem : a - algebraMap k R (c0 a) ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← residue_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, hc0, sub_self]
  rw [ht, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨b, hb.symm⟩

/-- Remove the constant residue coefficient and divide by the specified
generator of the maximal ideal. -/
def localTaylorRemainder : R →ₗ[k] R where
  toFun a := (exists_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht a).choose
  map_add' a b := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ ht0
    rw [mul_add, (exists_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht (a + b)).choose_spec,
      (exists_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht a).choose_spec,
      (exists_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht b).choose_spec]
    simp only [map_add]
    ring
  map_smul' c a := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ ht0
    rw [mul_smul_comm,
      (exists_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht (c • a)).choose_spec,
      (exists_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht a).choose_spec]
    change c • a - algebraMap k R (c0 (c • a)) =
      c • (a - algebraMap k R (c0 a))
    rw [c0.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, smul_sub, Algebra.smul_def c (algebraMap k R (c0 a))]

theorem mul_localTaylorRemainder (a : R) :
    t * localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a =
      a - algebraMap k R (c0 a) :=
  (exists_localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht a).choose_spec

include hc0 in
omit [IsDomain R] in
@[simp]
theorem localConstantTerm_algebraMap (c : k) : c0 (algebraMap k R c) = c := by
  apply (algebraMap k (ResidueField R)).injective
  change residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 (algebraMap k R c))) =
    residue R (algebraMap k R c)
  exact hc0 _

@[simp]
theorem localTaylorRemainder_algebraMap (c : k) :
    localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (algebraMap k R c) = 0 := by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ ht0
  rw [mul_localTaylorRemainder, localConstantTerm_algebraMap c0 hc0,
    sub_self, mul_zero]

include ht in
omit [IsDomain R] in
private theorem residue_parameter_eq_zero : residue R t = 0 := by
  rw [residue_eq_zero_iff, ht]
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self t

include hc0 ht in
omit [IsDomain R] in
theorem localConstantTerm_parameter_mul (a : R) : c0 (t * a) = 0 := by
  apply (algebraMap k (ResidueField R)).injective
  rw [map_zero, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k R (ResidueField R)]
  change residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 (t * a))) = 0
  rw [hc0, map_mul, residue_parameter_eq_zero t ht, zero_mul]

@[simp]
theorem localTaylorRemainder_parameter_mul (a : R) :
    localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (t * a) = a := by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ ht0
  rw [mul_localTaylorRemainder, localConstantTerm_parameter_mul c0 hc0 t ht,
    map_zero, sub_zero]

/-- The coefficient of degree `n` in the expansion in the specified parameter. -/
def localTaylorCoefficient (n : ℕ) : R →ₗ[k] k :=
  c0.comp (localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht ^ n)

@[simp]
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_zero (a : R) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht 0 a = c0 a := rfl

theorem localTaylorCoefficient_succ (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (n + 1) a =
      localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n
        (localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a) := by
  simp only [localTaylorCoefficient, pow_succ, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    Module.End.mul_apply]

/-- A constant has no positive Taylor coefficients. -/
@[simp]
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_algebraMap (n : ℕ) (c : k) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n (algebraMap k R c) =
      if n = 0 then c else 0 := by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [localConstantTerm_algebraMap c0 hc0]
  | succ n =>
    rw [localTaylorCoefficient_succ, localTaylorRemainder_algebraMap, map_zero]
    simp

@[simp]
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_one (n : ℕ) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n 1 = if n = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  simpa only [map_one] using localTaylorCoefficient_algebraMap c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n 1

@[simp]
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_succ_parameter_mul (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (n + 1) (t * a) =
      localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n a := by
  rw [localTaylorCoefficient_succ, localTaylorRemainder_parameter_mul]

/-- Multiplication by a parameter power shifts every Taylor coefficient. -/
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_add_parameter_pow_mul (n i : ℕ) (a : R) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (n + i) (t ^ n * a) =
      localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht i a := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, show n + 1 + i = (n + i) + 1 by omega,
      localTaylorCoefficient_succ_parameter_mul, ih]

/-- Coefficients below the order of a parameter power vanish. -/
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_parameter_pow_mul_eq_zero
    {n i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) (a : R) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht i (t ^ n * a) = 0 := by
  induction i generalizing n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hi)
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, localTaylorCoefficient_zero,
      localConstantTerm_parameter_mul c0 hc0 t ht]
  | succ i ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : n ≠ 0)
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, localTaylorCoefficient_succ_parameter_mul]
    exact ih (n := n) (by omega)

end
end Hartshorne
